name: ghost-mcp
description: Manage a Ghost site's posts, members, tags, tiers, offers and newsletters, with guardrails on what the AI can change.

ghost_api_url.title: Ghost site URL
ghost_api_url.description: Your site's URL with no trailing slash, e.g. https://yourblog.com

ghost_admin_api_key.title: Staff access token or Admin API key
ghost_admin_api_key.description: A staff access token from a limited-role staff user is safer: Ghost then enforces that role's permissions. An Admin API key has full admin rights.

ghost_api_version.title: Ghost API version
ghost_api_version.description: Accept-Version sent to Ghost, e.g. v5.0

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Only allow browsing and reading. Turn off to let the AI make changes.

tools.title: Allowed tools
tools.description: Optional comma-separated allowlist, e.g. posts_browse,posts_read,posts_edit. Leave empty for all tools.

allow.title: High-risk capabilities
allow.description: Optional comma-separated opt-ins: publish, webhooks, code_injection, privileged_invites, staff_email.
